verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms API-driven creation of deposit/wallet accounts under FBO structures (implying pass-through insurance) and unified infrastructure across sandbox-like environments, but there is no explicit mention of a sandbox environment, sandbox-to-production parity, or a documented end-to-end application-to-active-account flow. Probes also show no accessible API/OpenAPI docs to verify the programmatic flow. missing for 10: explicit sandbox environment/testing parity, explicit FDIC insurance disclosure, concrete API endpoint documentation for account provisioning flow.
